Help.HowToBuildDescription: To build your burger, start by selecting your desired ingredients from the list provided. Choose from a variety of options including fresh vegetables like lettuce, tomatoes, and onions, as well as cheeses, sauces, and premium toppings like avocado or bacon. Customize your burger to your liking by adding or removing ingredients as you go.
Help.CustomizingDescription: Take customization to the next level by selecting the type of bun, from classic options like sesame or brioche to gluten-free alternatives. Adjust the number of patties and layer on additional toppings or sauces to create your perfect burger. Whether you prefer a single, double, or even triple patty, the choice is yours!
Help.ReviewingDescription: Before placing your order, take a moment to review your burger creation. Ensure all selected ingredients are correct and make any necessary adjustments, such as changing quantities or removing items. Our review screen provides a clear summary of your choices to help you confirm your perfect burger before checkout.
Help.PlacingOrderDescription: Once your burger is just right, proceed by clicking the 'Place Order' button. You will be guided through our simple and secure checkout process, where you can enter your delivery details, choose a payment method, and finalize your order. Your burger will be on its way in no time!
Help.SpecialOffersDescription: Don’t miss out on our special offers! Visit the promotions section to discover current discounts and exclusive deals available for your order. Whether it's a limited-time discount or a combo deal, there's always an opportunity to save on your next burger.

Home.title: Build Your Perfect Custom Burger | Burger Builder
Home.description: Create and customize your dream burger online. Choose from fresh ingredients, watch your burger build in real-time, and get it delivered to your door.
Home.h1: Build Your Perfect Custom Burger Online
Home.seoText: Welcome to Burger Builder — the interactive online burger customizer. Choose from premium fresh ingredients including beef patties, crispy bacon, melted cheese, fresh lettuce, and more. Build your dream burger in real-time, save your favorite creations, discover meal deals, and order for delivery. Available in English and French.
Home.howToBuildText: Building your perfect burger has never been easier. Simply select your favorite ingredients — choose from juicy beef patties, crispy bacon strips, melted cheddar cheese, and fresh garden lettuce. Watch your burger come to life in real-time with our interactive burger builder. Once satisfied, proceed to checkout for fast delivery straight to your door.
Home.ingredientsText: We use only the highest quality ingredients. Every burger starts with a fresh-baked bun and can be customized with: premium beef or plant-based patties, aged cheddar cheese, crispy smoked bacon, fresh romaine lettuce, and signature sauces. No compromises — just great food.
Home.deliveryTitle: Fast Food Delivery to Your Door
Home.deliveryText: Hungry? Order now and get your custom burger delivered in as little as 30 minutes. We offer fast, reliable food delivery with real-time order tracking. Perfect for home delivery, office lunch, or any occasion.
Home.whyChoose1: 100% customizable — build exactly the burger you crave
Home.whyChoose4: Fast delivery with live order tracking

faq.question: How do I build a custom burger online?
faq.answer: Simply visit our interactive Burger Builder, select your preferred ingredients from the menu, and watch your burger build in real-time. Add beef patties, cheese, bacon, lettuce, and more — then place your order for delivery.

faq.question: Can I order a burger for delivery?
faq.answer: Yes! We offer fast burger delivery straight to your door. After building your custom burger, proceed to checkout and enter your delivery address. Estimated delivery time is 30–45 minutes.

faq.question: What burger ingredients are available?
faq.answer: We offer premium beef patties, crispy bacon, melted cheddar cheese, fresh lettuce, and more. You can fully customize your burger by adding or removing any ingredient to match your taste.

faq.question: Is there a minimum order for burger delivery?
faq.answer: Our minimum order starts from $4.00. Build your burger and check the total before placing your order. We also offer meal deals and combo packs for great value.

faq.question: Can I save my custom burger for later?
faq.answer: Yes! Create an account and you can save your favorite burger creations to re-order anytime. You'll also earn loyalty points with every order and unlock exclusive rewards.
